status: new diagnostic reanalysis; existing study locks unchanged
assay_evidence: membership in official MC3 best tumor-normal pairing table, matched at 15-character sample level
genotype_policy: OV: accept exact PASS or wga-only TP53 variants and D/W/X/G DNA analytes; exclude native_wga_mix, badseq, contest and only-nonpreferred context. Other six cohorts retain the previous native-DNA/PASS policy.
RNA_QC: RNASeqV2 platform, explicit Do_not_use=False and pathology exclusion=0; ambiguous or missing QC excluded
WT_definition: Operationally no qualifying MC3 TP53 call after the declared assay exclusions; OV known GDC-positive/MC3-negative discordances excluded. No biological WT or per-base callability guarantee.
ambiguous_TP53: exclude non-mutants with filtered protein-altering TP53 calls or classes outside the current seven-class definition
minimum_fit: current tool requirement: >=2 samples per arm and >=10 total; minor arm <20 flagged as small, not silently dropped
comparison: unadjusted TP53_mut minus TP53_wt, preserving the existing contrast
WGA_rescue: OV only: bare wga tag, as specified by Bailey et al. Cell 2018. Do not admit wga plus other flags.
enrichment: current repository fgseaMultilevel; Hallmark; seed=0; minSize=15; maxSize=500; nproc=1
inference_scope: Corrected diagnostic reanalysis; not a TP53 prevalence estimate for the whole TCGA-OV project, a causal TP53 effect, or an LLM accuracy result.
duplicate_expression_samples: Exclude all columns sharing a sample identifier; no arbitrary replicate selection
OV_GDC_rule: Exclude MC3-call-negative OV samples if the bundled current GDC snapshot contains a protein-altering TP53 call in the same case. Do not relabel them MUT or infer WT from absence in GDC. This is a case-level discordance guard, not sample-matched genotype integration.
